reason: Separate exact integer rejection certificate from floating FFT evaluation of an analytic global bound.
exact_test: For integer center z_n=x_n+i y_n, S=sum(x_n^2+y_n^2), C=sum(ceil_sqrt(x_n^2+y_n^2)); any constant-amplitude waveform satisfies residual_squared>=S-C^2/N. Thus N*S-C^2>2*N^2 exactly rejects all constant-amplitude waveforms within independent ideal square quantization cells, and hence any constant-amplitude sinusoid. Also record max cell radius lower squared and min upper squared; their strict separation independently rejects a common amplitude.
numerical_bound_status: The correlation-derivative covering theorem is exact analytically; floating FFT summary is numerical evidence only, not an outward-rounded interval certificate. Physical-noise bound remains absent.
